notes: Official JSR distribution, installed via its npm-compatible bridge. FetchClient.postJSON over the runtime's fetch with its defaults; a string body is sent as it is, with the Accept and Content-Type headers given by the adapter, and the parsed reply is response.data. A non-2xx status throws; a body that does not parse only fills response.problem, so the adapter also checks that data is present and that the status is 201.
